description: This file defines Data Access Objects (DAOs) for interacting with the database tables 'recipes' and 'notes' in an Android application using Room persistence library. It includes methods for CRUD operations, query filtering, and searching.

classes.name: RecipeDao
classes.description: Interface providing database operations related to 'recipes'.

classes.name: NoteDao
classes.description: Interface providing database operations related to 'notes' associated with recipes.

methods.name: getAll
methods.description: Retrieves all recipes ordered by title ascending.

methods.name: getByCategory
methods.description: Retrieves recipes filtered by category, ordered by title ascending.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a single recipe by its unique ID.

methods.name: insert
methods.description: Inserts a new recipe or replaces an existing one on conflict, returns the new row ID.

methods.name: search
methods.description: Searches recipes by a query matching title or instructions.

methods.name: setFavorite
methods.description: Sets the favorite status of a recipe by ID.

methods.name: getNotesForRecipe
methods.description: Retrieves notes associated with a specific recipe.
